clauses.text: For dates of service on or after 1 January 2026, a claim must be received by the plan within 180 days of the date of service.

clauses.section_heading: Filing limit for earlier dates of service
clauses.text: For dates of service before 1 January 2026, a claim must be received by the plan within 365 days of the date of service.
A corrected or replacement claim must be received within 90 days of the remittance date of the original decision. This limit applies even when the limit in clause TESS-TF-1.1 has already passed.

The filing limit is extended only in these situations: (a) the plan caused the delay, as shown by plan correspondence; (b) the member's coverage was added retroactively, in which case the limit runs from the date the plan notified the provider of eligibility; (c) another payer was billed first as primary, in which case the claim must be received within 90 days of the date on the primary payer's explanation of benefits.

Proof that a claim was filed on time is an electronic acceptance report, from the plan or from a clearinghouse, showing that the plan accepted the claim within the limit. A report showing only that the provider sent the claim, a screen print from the provider's billing system, or a report of a rejected claim is not proof.

A claim denied with reason code 29 is final when no situation in clause TESS-TF-2.1 applies and no proof under clause TESS-TF-2.2 exists. The amount is a provider write-off and the member may not be billed.
